review.assessment: This change introduces `solution.py` from scratch but implements `has_pair_with_sum` using two nested loops, resulting in quadratic $O(N^2)$ time complexity and failing to satisfy the task's explicit requirement for roughly linear execution speed. While the functional behavior is preserved and tests pass, the performance constraint is unmet.

findings.actual: A double nested loop iterating over all pairs (lines 4–6), yielding $O(N^2)$ time complexity regardless of input size.
findings.defect: Failure to meet linear-time performance requirement
findings.expected: An $O(N)$ or $O(N \log N)$ algorithm, typically using a hash set to store seen values and checking if the complement `(target - num)` exists.
